0022600223.text: The 4-7 New Orleans Pelicans, 12th in the West and on a three-game losing streak, host the 2-8 Brooklyn Nets, who are 13th in the East and have lost two straight, in the Pelicans' 12th game of the season. The Pelicans are without Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. Brooklyn is missing Mikel Brown Jr. (illness) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The series split 1-1 in 2025-26, and the most recent meeting was a 116-113 Pelicans win in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
